mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( id, account_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, created_on ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{executedPrice}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdOn} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, status FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, account_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, status, idempotency_key, created_on, rejection_reason FROM orders WHERE status = 'NEW' AND created_on < #{cutoff} ORDER BY created_on ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CONCAT('ORD-', id) AS order_id, account_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, created_on, rejection_reason FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_on = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'

UPDATE orders SET status = 'FILLED', executed_price = #{executedPrice}, filled_quantity = #{filledQuantity}, executed_on = #{executedOn}, updated_on = #{executedOn} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE orders SET fx_rate = #{fxRate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity * price * COALESCE(fx_rate, 1)), 0) FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND side = 'BUY' AND status = 'NEW'
